# CocoonTech

> > A community-driven home automation forum featuring HomeSeer scripts, hardware integration, and DIY smart home solutions.

CocoonTech is a long-standing home automation community focused on open-source solutions, custom scripting, and hardware platforms like Raspberry Pi, ESP32, and Arduino. The site features technical discussions, script repositories, product reviews, and tutorials for DIY smart home enthusiasts working with protocols like X10, UPB, and ZigBee.

## Key Topics

- HomeSeer automation platform
- Raspberry Pi & single-board computers
- X10 and UPB protocols
- Custom automation scripts
- ESP32 and Arduino microcontrollers
- ELK M1 Gold security system
- ZigBee wireless technology
- Virtual device integration
- DIY security systems
- Media Center extenders
- Dynamic DNS configuration
- Home theater automation
- Community contributors (electron, BraveSirRobbin, AutomatedOutlet)

## Hardware & Single-Board Computers

- [Hardware](https://cocoontech.com/forum/home-automation-hardware): Forum for ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi & microcontroller hardware
- [Single-Board Computers](https://cocoontech.com/forum/single-board-computers): Forum for Raspberry Pi, Banana Pi, Odroid & other SBC discussions

## HomeSeer Scripts & Plugins

- [Super Trigger 1.0](https://cocoontech.com/threads/super-trigger-1-0.9): HomeSeer plugin by electron for regex-based event automation triggers
- [Mosquito Activity 0.9](https://cocoontech.com/threads/mosquito-activity-0-9.14): HomeSeer script to monitor mosquito activity using skeeterbites.com data
- [Package Tracker 0.9 (beta)](https://cocoontech.com/threads/package-tracker-0-9-beta.121): Beta script for tracking FedEx, UPS, DHL & Airborne Express packages
- [MSN Traffic Reporter 0.9](https://cocoontech.com/threads/msn-traffic-reporter-0-9.15): HomeSeer script by electron to publish MSN traffic alerts via virtual device
- [Blockbuster 1.1](https://cocoontech.com/threads/blockbuster-1-1.11): HomeSeer script to fetch latest Blockbuster video releases

## Tutorials & How-To Guides

- [[How-To] Configuring no-ip.com](https://cocoontech.com/threads/how-to-configuring-no-ip-com.83): Tutorial by BraveSirRobbin on setting up No-IP dynamic DNS service
- [Motion Sensors/Security Systems](https://cocoontech.com/threads/motion-sensors-security-systems.8): DIY security system discussion using Ocelot & SECU16I modules
